reviews.title: Don’t Buy Unless You Want To Get The Expensive Subscription
reviews.text:
The base version of this app is cool if you only care about what is happening above you right now.
If you care about the past or future you are required to buy the pro tier 2 subscription at $100 a year, not cheap. 
This app should’ve been free. DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY on the base version of the app unless you want it to take even more of your money to get the same info The Weather Channel app gives you.

reviews.title: Too Many Features Behind Subscription
reviews.text: CAUTION!!!  I expected more features to be included with app purchase price. No refund offered even if immediately determined app is not what one is looking for. I would not recommend trying this app.

reviews.title: 12 min of loop
reviews.text: The duration of radar loop provided in the basic $10 app is 12 minutes - not long enough and not disclosed by number of frames in product description - looking for non subscription based app - already subscribed to death

reviews.title: I PAID $10….
reviews.text:
And now they want more in yearly or monthly fees, I don’t believe you should have to pay $10 down First. But everybody wants paid more for less! $10 gives you nothing.
Keep the 10 bucks. I deleted it.

reviews.title: Don’t Download
reviews.text: They will charge you without any notice. The app’s quality would only be noteworthy if the year was 1948.

reviews.title: Restore purchases all the time
reviews.text: I’m getting tired of being asked to restore purchases ALL THE TIME. I have a paid for Pro Tier 2, verified in my Apple subscriptions. Same Apple account for everything. To make matters worse it asks me for my Apple password. How do I know this isn’t the app stealing my password?????

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Paid $10 and it doesn’t show anything, all features require a subscription upgrade for more money. Do yourself a favor and download windy.

reviews.title: They charge for the app and then expect a subscription
reviews.text: $10 for the application, then extremely limited without a subscription. I would avoid this. I would understand either charging for the app or for a subscription, but doing both is unreasonable.

reviews.title: Filter Watches and Warnings
reviews.text: There should be a way to filter watches and warnings to a particular geographic region. I don’t really care about what’s going on 2,500 miles away.

reviews.title: Gulf of America - really?
reviews.text: I’ve used (and loved) this app for years. I was very disappointed to discover today that the company caved to the nut job in the WH. I won’t be continuing my subscription when it expires.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Everything cool is behind a subscription. Looking for a way to get a refund. There’s better free apps.

reviews.title: Outdated Radar Info
reviews.text: I loved this app in the past, however, recently I noticed it’s been very unreliable. During critical times, the radar does not update and loops old radar data. I checked the source and it’s up to date on there, but just not on the app. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: App uses free NOAA data to milk people for subscriptions. You’re better off opening the NOAA site on your phone in the US.

reviews.title: Don’t Buy! Feels like a scam
reviews.text: What a waste. Not only do you have to pay 10$ to even download the app, to get any sort of information you have to pay AT MINIMUM another 10$ to actually use the app. It’s an appalling display of greed, to hide potentially life saving information behind two different pay walls.

reviews.title: Really wanted to love this.
reviews.text: Good features are rendered almost useless as the only way to view more than a ten minute radar loop is to pay for a subscription in addition to the up-front payment. Make the payment upfront of make it all subscription, but the deception feels unkind and unpleasant.

reviews.title: Don’t pay unless you want subscription
reviews.text: The paid app sucks, all the functionality requires an additional monthly subscription. If you want to buy all that, it’s great, but they don’t tell you how little you get for the $10 payment. I’m deleting. Wasted my money

reviews.title: Underwhelming
reviews.text: I thought I was buying an app that was at the very least comparable to the free MyRadar app, and at the very least with resolution quality that looks like their logo. Instead I got a heavily pixelated radar image that is basically useless. Plus there ARE NO FORECAST GRAPHS! I paid $10 for basically nothing. In essence, I got scammed by AI who said this was the best app. What a joke.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Used to be a great app, however they  stripped down the basic app (currently sad) and for another price you can upgrade 😞 too a the second or third level…. Lord

reviews.title: Subscription Required
reviews.text: The app costs $9. All you get with that is radar of your area for the last 10 minutes. If you want the previous 30 minutes you need to upgrade to the “Pro 1” subscription. If you want radar that’s more historical than that you need yo upgrade to “Pro 2.” I’m writing this review as a caution to any of those (like me) that only saw really positive reviews - making no mention of subscriptions.

reviews.title: PLEASE FIX super relativity radar
reviews.text: Subscribed the Pro Version.  Usually works great but it hasn’t been working for the past couple of days.  Need to fix the super relativity.  Only the digital relativity works right now.

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Bought the original app years ago and they just keep stealing back the original functionality.  Don’t waste your money.  It’s slow and can get you killed if used for storm ground based observation.  Use NOAA tools, PIKL or other free expert tools from NWS.   Losers.

reviews.title: Radar won’t update
reviews.text: Normally this app is amazing, today today won’t update. I’ve clicked on multiple “agencies” around my area and the newest is from 7:50 this morning….its 5:58pm right now…the one I normally use says it was last updated 1 day 3 hours and 33 minutes. I’ve closed the app out many times now and still nothing. Please get this fixed. There’s storms all week and I rely on this app specially because it’s the most accurate radar map I have found.

reviews.text: Doesn’t even do composite imagery for the $9.99 version… You can only select one radar side at a time. Really poor, uninstalling

And pro2 for longer? Trash business model this all free info elsewhere. Many reviews on reddit likely fake to get buys.

reviews.title: Exceptional Raw Data
reviews.text:
I’ve been using RadarScope since its inception back in 2008, and I’ve been consistently impressed with how far it has come over the years. The progression in available features, performance and overall capability has been remarkable, all while remaining reasonably priced for what it offers.

This is my go-to app for tracking storms in real time. Whether I’m looking at precipitation intensity, velocity data, or correlation coefficient, the level of detail on this mobile app is outstanding. It provides the kind of information you’d expect from professional grade tools, right in your hand.

In my opinion, there simply isn’t another mobile weather app that matches RadarScope in terms of capability, reliability and depth of data. If you’re serious about weather, this app is hard to beat!

reviews.title: A lot of Hype but...
reviews.text:
Thinking it sounded like a good deal I paid $10. It seemed to be a quality weather app.  Instead you get  to see one radar station at a time. lol. That's $10 I'll never get back. 

You're better off just stepping outside and looking up.

reviews.title: New update is terrible
reviews.text: This has been my “go-to” app for years, but this new update makes it much less functional. If this update remains, I wouldn’t recommend downloading it.

reviews.title: Map color change
reviews.text: Usually this app is a 5 plus!! But the new color change of the weather legend, has done nothing but cause confusion!! Not a app to use for weather safety, with this configuration!! Unfortunate!! Would not recommend!!

reviews.title: Deceptive
reviews.text: Charges you 9.99 just to download the base app, then wants an additional 9.99/year to unlock most of the features.

reviews.title: Unnecessary subscriptions
reviews.text: Imagine paying $9.99 to download an app, and then imagine being asked to pay another $9.99, yearly, to access weather Watch statements.

reviews.title: Refund ?
reviews.text:
Instant disappointment.

After the reviews I read, no data tracking , recent updates , I thought this would be the one.  I have never spent 10 bucks , only to get a pixelated low detail radar that doesn’t even compare to local radar.  

Add free was also a nice bonus but not worth the money .  Deleting this.

reviews.title: Wrong price displayed
reviews.text: Before I even open this app. The price displayed is $9.99 out the price that was charged $17.99. I’m going to keep this happen anyway, but this should probably be fixed.

reviews.title: MRMS shouldn’t be Tier 2
reviews.text: RadarScope has long been a leader in this space, but there are now several competitive alternatives. While a $10 app price is reasonable, placing MRMS behind the Tier 2 subscription is difficult to justify when the same feature is available for free on WeatherWise and WeatherFront. For this reason, I will not be renewing my Tier 1 subscription.

reviews.title: Weather app/radar app
reviews.text: I could be missing something but I thought I was paying for a whole weather app and not just a radar. For me, the app isn’t any better than WAPP fox 4 which is a whole weather app. My intention was to upgrade - I did - $10 for app and another $10 for pro that I thought would get me a whole weather app again. I respectfully request a refund or an explanation/directions to accomplish my goal to have a completely upgraded weather app.

reviews.title: Good app but too money hungry
reviews.text: I got this app for 10 bucks just for everything to be pro tier 2 or 1 like I bet that I can find an app that has almost everything that this app has but more for FREE

reviews.title: Not worth paying for
reviews.text: It shows the radar but it doesn’t even show all the cities or terrain or anything.  Not useful to me as a sportsman and outdoor enthusiast

reviews.title: Lightning
reviews.text: Have to upgrade to Pro just to get lightning overlay.  No thanks, plenty of great radar options including lightning that don’t require a subscription.
